This Is To Notify And Warn The Legally Qualified Electors Of The City Of East Providence, That The General Election Shall Be Held On 
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 3, 2026
The Polls Will Be Open From 7:00 AM To 8:00 PM

EARLY VOTING SHALL COMMENCE WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2026
EARLY VOTING CAN ONLY BE DONE AT EAST PROVIDENCE CITY HALL AT 145 TAUNTON AVE, EAST PROVIDENCE, RI ON THE FIRST FLOOR DURING THE FOLLOWING SCHEDULE
MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY 8AM-4PM
THURDAY 8AM-6PM
FRIDAY 8AM-1PM
SATURDAY’S EARLY VOTING ONLY: 10/24 & 10/31 8AM-1PM
PLEASE BE AWARE THAT NO APPOINTMENTS WILL BE MADE FOR EARLY VOTING.
EARLY VOTING IS STRICTLY ON A FIRST COME, FIRST SERVE BASIS DURING THE SCHEDULED WALK-IN TIME PERIODS.
VIEW SAMPLE BALLOT PLEASE VISIT   VOTE.RI.GOV
Please Call 435-7502 If You Have Any Questions Regarding Your Polling Place
